name: velvet-vine
description: Velvet Vine website — Next.js frontend, NestJS API, SQLite database

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.db:reset: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('database/app.sqlite',{force:true});console.log('Database removed; it will be recreated and re-seeded on next API start.')"
